# Security Window Bars (SWB)

> > Patented telescopic security window bars offering DIY installation, emergency-exit functionality, and modular protection for residential properties.

SWB (Security Windows Bars S.a. de C.V.) specializes in adjustable, telescopic security bars across three main product models (Model A, Model A-EXIT, and Model B) designed for quick 15-minute installation without professional help. Available through Amazon USA and Amazon Mexico.
